title: MetaMask core headless Perps advanced order types (TAT-3511)
description: Proves the advanced order-type contract added by TAT-3511 — stop market, stop limit, take-profit market, take-profit limit, reduce-only as a placement flag, and partial (quantity-scoped) TP/SL. Each type runs place -> visible in open-orders state with the correct trigger data (placement type, trigger price, execution mode, reduce-only, partial quantity) -> cancel -> asserted gone, through the package's real mapping and read-back paths (calculateOrderPriceAndSize, buildOrdersArray, adaptOrderFromSDK, adaptPositionTriggerOrderFromSDK). The matrix is shared with the Jest contract guard, which this recipe also runs and then mutates on purpose to prove the guard is not vacuous. Headless: no CDP, bridge, or UI.

status.intent: Resolve the core checkout and report headless compatibility mode

e2e_matrix.intent: Run every advanced order type through place -> read back -> assert trigger data -> cancel -> assert gone, and write per-case evidence

e2e_matrix_exit.intent: The matrix run must exit 0 — any failed case or check fails the run

assert_all_pass.intent: Every case in the evidence summary reports pass

assert_stop_market_type.intent: A stop market order reads back with its placement type in open-orders state

assert_stop_market_execution.intent: Execution mode round-trips as market (HyperLiquid sets limitPx on trigger orders as a slippage cap, which used to read back as limit)

assert_stop_limit_execution.intent: A stop limit order reads back as limit execution on trigger

assert_take_profit_market_type.intent: A take-profit market order reads back with its placement type

assert_take_profit_limit_type.intent: A take-profit limit order reads back with its placement type

assert_reduce_only_flag.intent: Reduce-only survives placement as a first-class flag and is visible in open-orders state

assert_partial_size.intent: A partial take profit rests for its own quantity (0.04 of a 0.1 order), not the full size

assert_partial_flag.intent: Position state flags the trigger as partial so clients can render it

assert_cancelled.intent: Every placed order is gone from open-orders state after cancel

assert_typed_error.intent: A trigger placement with no trigger price fails with a typed error instead of silently placing a market order

contract_guard.cmd: cd packages/perps-controller && NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules yarn jest tests/src/e2e/advanced-orders.contract.test.ts tests/src/utils/orderTypes.test.ts tests/src/utils/orderCalculations.advanced-orders.test.ts tests/src/utils/hyperLiquidValidation.advanced-orders.test.ts tests/src/utils/hyperLiquidAdapter.advanced-orders.test.ts tests/src/providers/HyperLiquidProvider.advanced-orders.test.ts --no-coverage
contract_guard.intent: Run the CI guard that replays this same matrix plus the per-unit tests, so the contract cannot regress unnoticed

contract_guard_exit.intent: The CI guard passes on the current tree

guard_bites.cmd: cd packages/perps-controller && cp src/utils/hyperLiquidAdapter.ts "$TMPDIR/adapter.bak" && sed -i '' "s/    orderType = getTriggerExecution(triggerOrderType);/    orderType = 'limit';/" src/utils/hyperLiquidAdapter.ts && (NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules yarn jest tests/src/e2e/advanced-orders.contract.test.ts --no-coverage >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo GUARD_DID_NOT_BITE || echo GUARD_BIT); cp "$TMPDIR/adapter.bak" src/utils/hyperLiquidAdapter.ts
guard_bites.intent: Mutation check: break the trigger execution read-back on purpose, confirm the guard fails, then restore the file

guard_bites_assert.intent: The guard must fail on the mutated tree — otherwise it proves nothing

notes.runner_gap: The runner's `metamask.perps.place_order` action currently accepts only `order_type: market | limit`, so the new placement types cannot yet be driven through `metamask.perps.*` nodes. Once its schema gains `order_type: stop_market | stop_limit | take_profit_market | take_profit_limit`, plus `trigger_price` and `take_profit_size` / `stop_loss_size`, this recipe should be rewritten on those nodes (place_order -> assert_orders -> close_orders per type) to sign real HyperLiquid testnet orders through the controller. Tracked as a follow-up against the recipe runner, not this package.
notes.testnet: Until then, the same matrix runs against real HyperLiquid testnet through the package script: `npx tsx e2e/advanced-orders.e2e.ts --mode=testnet --symbol=BTC` with `PERPS_E2E_PRIVATE_KEY` and `PERPS_E2E_ADDRESS` set. See e2e/README.md.
